controls.label: Page heading
controls.text: Choose how Synder organizes your transactions

controls.label: Subheading
controls.text: Synder can record every transaction individually, or group them into summary entries.

controls.label: Mode description
controls.text: Every order, refund and fee arrives in QuickBooks as its own entry.

controls.label: Benefit lines
text: Each order is a separate entry, under the customer's name.
You can search your books by customer, order number or product.
Sales tax is recorded order by order, by tax code — down to county or city.

controls.label: Downside line
controls.text: info Your register grows with your order volume — one entry per sale, refund and fee.

controls.label: Mode description
controls.text: Your sales arrive in QuickBooks as one summarized entry — daily, or per payout.

controls.label: Benefit lines
text: One entry per day or per payout, however many orders it covers.
Totals are split into income, shipping, tax, discounts and fees.
The entry matches your bank deposit in one line, so month-end reconciliation clears quickly.

controls.label: Downside line
controls.text: info Customer and order names stay in Synder — QuickBooks shows totals only.

after_interaction.note: exactly one card carries the selected state at a time; both remain visible and clickable

controls.label: Recommended chip with "?" and tooltip
controls.text: Recommended ?  →  We suggest this from the role and industry you gave in the previous step — a business owner running a retail store. You can pick either mode.
